items.text: Krystle Palmer is the City Treasurer of Burbank, appointed in 2019 and elected in 2020 and 2022. Her official biography notes she has over 20 years of finance and strategy experience. She states the city's investment portfolio grew from about $430 million in 2019 to about $730 million under her management.

sentences.text: Krystle Palmer is the City Treasurer of Burbank, appointed in 2019 and elected in 2020 and 2022.
Her official biography notes she has over 20 years of finance and strategy experience.
She states the city's investment portfolio grew from about $430 million in 2019 to about $730 million under her management.

items.text: She says she led the integration of Environmental, Social, and Corporate Governance (ESG) principles into Burbank's investment policy. In 2024, the city received the California Municipal Treasurers Association Investment Policy Certification. Her biography states her office launched a universal children's savings program that gives $50 for each new baby born in Burbank. She is president of the California Municipal Treasurers Association.
